sentences.text: The FIR unfolds that the victim was married to Sunny Das on 25.11.2022 and from the threshold of her marriage she was subjected to cruelty by her husband, who used to assault her to meet his illegal demand of dowry.
The other accused also used to subject the victim to cruelty.
4. I have considered the submissions at the Bar and I have also perused the case diary.
5. The learned Addl. P.P. has raised serious objections stating that the petitioner has admitted that he is complicit.
6. There are indeed incriminating materials in the case diary against the petitioner.
7. The investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
The petitioner is a local resident.
The petitioner has appeared before the I/O and his statement Page No.# 3/3 has been recorded and he has cooperated with the investigation.
He has not violated any bail conditions.
8. Considering all aspects, the interim bail order dated 12.10.2023 is hereby made absolute.
